q: How do loans and subsidy payments work under PM Surya Ghar?
title: PM Surya Ghar loans and subsidy payment
short: Loans are offered through the national portal, and MNRE expects banks to offer standard low-interest loans around repo plus 0.5% for systems up to 3 kW. The subsidy is processed within 15 days of discom approval and goes first to the loan account, with any balance to your bank account.
audience: Households and RWAs financing rooftop solar

ul: Loan products from banks and financial institutions are listed on the national portal, including through the Jan Samarth portal.
MNRE envisages standard low-interest products around repo plus 50 basis points for residential systems up to 3 kW.
Similar standard products are expected for systems above 3 kW, which get no extra subsidy.

ol: The vendor installs; the discom inspects and approves.
The claim is processed within 15 days of discom approval.
If you took a loan, the subsidy goes to the loan account up to the amount outstanding, and any remainder to your bank account.

p: Keep the commissioning report, net meter agreement and generation readings. They are the evidence for any solar claim later, including on a housing society's or home office's electricity figures.

senseible: Senseible reads electricity bills, including net metering lines, so grid import, export and solar generation sit in one monthly record with the factor and source shown. Figures are self-declared.

sources.label: MNRE Guidelines for PM-Surya Ghar: Muft Bijli Yojana, Central Financial Assistance to Residential Consumers
